children: National Australia Bank's business survey is due out on Tuesday. The survey's condition index, which empirically has the most reliable correlation with real growth in gross national expenditure, has fallen sharply this year and. Outside of the pandemic, the index is running at its weakest level since 2013, says Ben Jarman, chief economist at J.P.Morgan. The survey's pricing metrics will also be important to watch, particularly the final price index, which holds the closest correlation with headline consumer inflation, he adds.
